biotools.summary: MultiRNAflow is an R package designed for integrated analysis of temporal RNA-seq data with multiple biological conditions. It provides a unified framework for both unsupervised and supervised analyses, including identifying temporal patterns and differentially expressed genes specific to particular conditions.
